schema.name: ai_insights
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_insights (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, type TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
        is_read INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )

schema.name: budgets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE budgets (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, category_id INTEGER, amount REAL NOT NULL, period TEXT DEFAULT 'monthly',
        start_date TEXT, end_date TEXT, alert_threshold REAL DEFAULT 80, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
      )

schema.name: categories
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE categories (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, icon TEXT DEFAULT '📦',
        color TEXT DEFAULT '#6366f1', type TEXT DEFAULT 'expense', created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      , group_name TEXT)

schema.name: category_classification
net_worth
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE net_worth (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('asset','liability')),
        amount REAL NOT NULL, category TEXT DEFAULT 'other', date TEXT NOT NULL, notes TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )

schema.name: recurring_rules
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE recurring_rules (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, description TEXT NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL,
        category_id INTEGER, interval TEXT NOT NULL, next_date TEXT NOT NULL, is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )

schema.name: savings_contributions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE savings_contributions (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, goal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL, note TEXT,
        date TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (goal_id) REFERENCES savings_goals(id)
      )

schema.name: savings_goals
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE savings_goals (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, icon TEXT DEFAULT '🎯', target_amount REAL NOT NULL,
        current_amount REAL DEFAULT 0, deadline TEXT, color TEXT DEFAULT '#6366f1', category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',
        notes TEXT, is_completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )

schema.name: transactions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE transactions (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, amount REAL NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('income','expense')),
        category_id INTEGER, description TEXT, date TEXT NOT NULL, payment_method TEXT DEFAULT 'cash',
        tags TEXT DEFAULT '[]', is_recurring INTEGER DEFAULT 0, recurring_interval TEXT, notes TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
      )
